### Aristotle on virtue

Aristotle (384–322 BCE) approaches virtue within Peripatetic. Aristotle pursued demonstrative science grounded in observation, definition, and causal explanation. His Organon developed syllogistic logic and standards of proof that structured Western reasoning for two millennia. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets virtue most directly—useful for searches such as “aristotle quotes on virtue.”

### How to use this page

Start with the shortest passage, then compare tone across sources. Return to the [Aristotle thinker page](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/aristotle) for biography and to the [virtue theme](https://www.philosophydef.com/themes/virtue) for other voices on the same question.
